newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BROKERAGE REACTIONS TO GEVAERT/ALMANIJ/COBEPA DEAL.
newsitem.headline: BROKERAGE REACTIONS TO GEVAERT/ALMANIJ/COBEPA DEAL.

text.p: Here are some first reactions from brokerages following the announcement on Friday of plans to effectively divide Gevaert's portfolio between the Almanij and Cobepa groups:

BBL/Vermeulen-Raemdonck: "The transaction allows Cobepa to simplify its structure by eliminating a level of discount, and significantly increase the liquidity of the share. Furthermore, a substantial part of the Gevaert portfolio is readily realisable and can help Cobepa realise its strategic options."
RATINGS: Almanij - HOLD; Cobepa - BUY; Gevaert - HOLD

Corluy & Co: "The deal as a whole is very good for the Belgian market, which has always been pressured by holdings with too big discounts. Gevaert was one of these. It's a win-win situation for the others: Cobepa had too great a discount and it's good news for Almanij, which now has extra potential and looks likely to open considerably higher.

Generale Bank: "Almanij will take over part of the Gevaert portfolio with a lot of former Gevaert shareholders now participating in Almanij. For Cobepa, (it) implies a simplification of its structure. The stake Cobepa holds in Gevaert today will be replaced by direct stakes in operational companies. This confirms Cobepa's intentions to further increase shareholder value by reducing the number of intermediary levels"
RATINGS: Almanij - BUY; Cobepa - BUY; Gevaert - HOLD
